main_body: Two vertical wooden posts with a cloth hammock slung between them in a U-shaped curve
top_band: none — the posts are drawn as plain vertical columns with only a 1-2px lighter cap at the top (rows 6-7); no top surface on the posts. The hammock is a front-view curve with no visible top surface
evidence: Reading a column through a post: a thin orange highlight at rows 6-7 then the flat orange-brown face down to a dark base at rows 28-30. The cap is only 1-2px, with no top surface, and the base has no visible top face. The hammock is a flat U-shaped front silhouette, with no horizontal surface seen from above (no visible inside of the cloth). This is a front elevation, like the rim-only/flat-cap columns in the guide.

style.evidence: The posts have only about 3 tones (a light edge, a mid orange-brown, a dark brown edge) and are large flat fills with no grain or knots. The hammock cloth has about 3-4 cream/grey steps with no weave texture. The outline is a dark brown tint, which is acceptable, but the tiles carry far fewer colours than the stall and well references, so the piece looks thinner and flatter.
